description: Datasets used in Fish-PACE tutorials and hackweeks: BGC-Argo, OOI and IOOS glider CHLA profiles with PACE and OLCI matchups (versions are the repository's release tags), and IFCB daily abundance.
license: Open access where specified by each dataset's source; see per-item metadata.

properties.title: Argo CHLA profile metrics (0–200 m, 10 m bins)
properties.description: Per-profile CHLA metrics from global BGC-Argo floats (Mar 2024–Oct 2026), ascending profiles only, depth-binned 0–200 m in 10 m bins (A < PRES <= B) from CHLA_ADJUSTED levels with CHLA_ADJUSTED_QC in {1, 2, 5, 8}. Source: Ifremer ERDDAP via argopy 1.5.0 (expert mode), pulled 2026-11-06.
properties.license: Open access (Argo Data Policy); unrestricted use with attribution.

data.title: Argo CHLA profile metrics (0–200 m, 10 m bins)

properties.title: Argo CHLA profile metrics (0–200 m, 10 m bins) with PACE matchups
properties.description: Per-profile CHLA metrics from global BGC-Argo floats (Mar 2024–Oct 2026), ascending profiles only, depth-binned 0–200 m in 10 m bins (A < PRES <= B) from CHLA_ADJUSTED levels with CHLA_ADJUSTED_QC in {1, 2, 5, 8}. Source: Ifremer ERDDAP via argopy 1.5.0 (expert mode), pulled 2026-11-06. Matched to PACE OCI Level-3 4 km Daily V3.2 Rrs (PACE_OCI_L3M_AOP), chlor_a (PACE_OCI_L3M_BGC) and Kd_490 (PACE_OCI_L3M_KD, band 489.674 nm): a profile matches a granule when its time is within 24 h after the granule's time_coverage_start, at the nearest 4 km cell; standard files are used before NRT. Only profiles with a matching Rrs granule are kept; Rrs is NaN where the pixel was masked (cloud, glint).
properties.license: Open access (Argo Data Policy); unrestricted use with attribution.

data.title: Argo CHLA profile metrics (0–200 m, 10 m bins) with PACE matchups

properties.title: OOI CHLA profile metrics (0–200 m, 10 m bins)
properties.description: CHLA metrics from OOI profilers and moorings (Mar 2024–Oct 2026), one row per instrument and 3 h window of local solar time, depth-binned 0–200 m in 10 m bins (A < depth <= B, as for Argo) from samples with qc_agg = 1, using true depths for fixed-depth instruments, and divided by the Sauzède et al. fluorescence:chlorophyll ratio for the site (column chla_ratio). Time is the mean time of the window's samples. Source: OOI ERDDAP.
properties.license: Open access; unrestricted use with attribution.

properties.title: Argo CHLA profile metrics (0–200 m, 10 m bins) with OLCI matchups
properties.description: Per-profile CHLA metrics from global BGC-Argo floats (Mar 2024–Oct 2026), ascending profiles only, depth-binned 0–200 m in 10 m bins (A < PRES <= B) from CHLA_ADJUSTED levels with CHLA_ADJUSTED_QC in {1, 2, 5, 8}. Source: Ifremer ERDDAP via argopy 1.5.0 (expert mode), pulled 2026-11-06. Matched to Sentinel-3 OLCI Level-3 4 km Daily Rrs (OLCIS3A_L3m_ERR_RRS, OLCIS3B_L3m_ERR_RRS; 11 bands 400–709 nm) for every profile on a day with an OLCI file (to 2026-10-01): the file of the profile's UTC day, nearest 4 km cell, S3A first then S3B. Columns pace_granule and pace_Rrs_valid flag whether the profile also has a PACE match, so OLCI can be compared with PACE on the same profiles or used on its own. OLCI Rrs is NaN where the pixel was masked.
properties.license: Open access (Argo Data Policy); unrestricted use with attribution.

properties.title: Glider CHLA profile metrics (0–200 m, 10 m bins)
properties.description: CHLA metrics from 20 IOOS Glider DAC deployments (Slocum and Spray gliders; Mar 2024–Oct 2026) in six regions (California Current, Mid-Atlantic Bight and slope, Southern New England shelf, off Cape Hatteras / South Atlantic Bight, Antarctic Peninsula, tropical Atlantic), one row per deployment and 3 h window of local solar time keeping one glider profile per window, depth-binned 0–200 m in 10 m bins (A < depth <= B) from samples passing the dataset's QC flag, and divided by the Sauzède et al. fluorescence:chlorophyll ratio (column chla_ratio), as for OOI. The raw fluorometer bins (CHLA_FLUOR_A_B) and a deep (dark) offset (dark_offset, not subtracted) are kept as columns. Source: IOOS Glider DAC ERDDAP.
properties.license: Open access (U.S. IOOS); unrestricted use with attribution to the Glider DAC and the operating institution.

properties.title: IFCB Daily Taxonomic Abundance (objects per mL) — WHOI IFCB Data Archive
properties.description: Daily taxon-specific abundance estimates derived from Imaging FlowCytobot (IFCB) instruments in the WHOI IFCB Data Archive. Each daily summary is generated by aggregating per-bin classification outputs over a calendar day and converting classifier results into taxon-specific object concentrations (objects/mL) using a winner-takes-all approach. Metadata typically include sampling location (latitude/longitude), instrument identifier, analyzed volume, classification threshold, and per-taxon abundance. At present, this dataset directory includes MVCO as the first processed site, with additional IFCB sites intended to be added over time.

data.title: IFCB daily taxonomic abundance (objects per mL) — datasets/ifcb
